entry.title: /o/ Auto: Negotiation
entry.content: Okay, what's your way of negotiating car deals? I usually send an email to multiple dealerships asking for a price. When a dealership replies, I send another email saying how much of a discount I want. Most of them would never reply back but the few who did would offer me a slightly better price but never my price. Then I pick one and go with it because I don't want to lose those few.
